title: finding(console,plugin-dashboard): the bare `dashboard` key is claimed by two DIFFERENT full types — and the `plugin-dashboard:dashboard` lazy stub is never cleared, so it stays unsatisfiable forever
body:
Dedup keywords: `dashboard` bare key · `plugin-dashboard` lazy stub never cleared · unsatisfiable namespaced key · objectui#6416 shape · `known-schema-types`

Measured by the `os-dev` seat delivering objectui#9264 (PR objectui#9531), on a **BUILT** tree, and filed by the `domain:ui` execution seat. ⛔ Unassigned and ungraded — grading is triage's.

⭐ **This is the ONE genuinely contested bare key in the repository**, out of 237 distinct bare keys claimed by 425 registrations across 147 files. It appears on **neither** inherited list — not objectui#9256's nine hold-outs, and not the nineteen names objectui#9264's own body carried.

## The contest

| claimant | full type | `skipFallback` | via |
|---|---|---|---|
| `apps/console/src/preview-gallery.tsx:36` | `plugin-dashboard:dashboard` | no | `registerLazy` |
| `apps/console/src/register-plugins.ts:65` | `plugin-dashboard:dashboard` | no | `registerLazy` |
| `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/index.tsx:79` | `view:dashboard` | no | `register` |

⇒ bare `dashboard` declares namespace `plugin-dashboard` **before** the chunk loads and `view` **after** it. In objectui#6416's own words about the same shape: *"which answer a host got depended on when it asked"*.

⚠️ And it goes through the **unguarded** door. `Registry.register` at least prints a warning that begins `bare-name fallback is being overwritten by`; `Registry.registerLazy` takes the same `meta?.namespace && !meta?.skipFallback` branch with **no collision check at all**. Two of the three claimants here are `registerLazy`.

## ⭐ The second consequence, which is the part worth a card of its own

objectui#6416 recorded **two** consequences of this shape. The bare-key contest above is the first. The second follows here and was unmeasured until now:

`register()` clears the lazy stub for **the type it registers** — and the type `packages/plugin-dashboard` registers is **`view:dashboard`**. So the `plugin-dashboard:dashboard` stub is **never cleared**:

- no component is ever stored under `plugin-dashboard:dashboard`;
- `hasLazy('dashboard', 'plugin-dashboard')` stays `true` **forever**;
- `packages/cli/src/utils/known-schema-types.ts` lists all three spellings — `dashboard`, `view:dashboard`, `plugin-dashboard:dashboard` — as renderable.

⇒ the generated whitelist advertises a spelling that can never resolve. That is exactly the pair objectui#6416 converged `plugin-report` off, by moving the package onto the namespace the console stub already used.

## ⚠️ What is NOT measured

⛔ **Read off `Registry.register`'s own lazy-clearing lines, ⛔ NOT executed in a live registry.** Whoever takes this reproduces it against a real `Registry` before acting — objectui#6416's own pin (`report-bare-key-ownership.test.ts`) exists because *"asserting only today's resolved outcome cannot tell 'declared' apart from 'happened to be observed after the right step'"*, and it replays registrations in **both orders** for that reason.

⛔ **Import order itself is not measured.** The verdict is "two declarations claim this name", ⛔ not "declaration A wins today".

## ⛔ Not pre-judged

Picking a spelling decides which declaration governs an authored `{ "type": "dashboard" }` node. That is the same class of ruling objectui#9256 holds registrations for, and ⛔ it is not the filing seat's:

1. **Converge on `plugin-dashboard`** — the objectui#6416 remedy, and the spelling every sibling plugin plus the CLI whitelist already uses. ⚠️ Measure first whether anything authors `view:dashboard`.
2. **Converge on `view`** — and give the console stubs `skipFallback: true`. ⚠️ Leaves the CLI whitelist advertising a dead `plugin-dashboard:dashboard`.
3. **Stand one side down without converging** — resolves the bare-key contest but ⛔ NOT the unsatisfiable stub, which is a separate defect in the same site.

## Related

- objectui#9264 / PR objectui#9531 — the gate that made this decidable; its shrink-only ledger already carries this row, so ⛔ landing a fix here shrinks that ledger rather than editing prose.
- objectui#6416 — the same shape, converged for `plugin-report`; `report-bare-key-ownership.test.ts` and `timeline-bare-key-ownership.test.ts` are the technique.
- objectui#9256 — holds eleven registrations for the same class of ruling. ⛔ `dashboard` is **not** among them.
